summary: Fixed the ledger package so all 755 unit tests pass. Fixes: half-away-from-zero rounding through ledger.core, a single leading minus in amount formatting (including the HTML total cell), a header-over-dialect layout order, a jurisdiction header on write, exact month_range usage in the rate file reader, a prior-month-only rate lookup, per-entry rounded totals, reversals booked and valued on the original's date, tax rules effective on their start date, fiscal quarter boundaries, and returns grouped by valuation quarter. tools/audit.py is clean except one rule 6.2 check that expects a 3-month lookback; I followed docs/conventions.md, which says 6 months (MAX_LOOKBACK = 6), so that single audit check still fails.
